message.content:
Based on the search results, **Procol Harum** was the first to sing "A Whiter Shade of Pale." The song was released as their debut single on **May 12, 1967**. 

The original recording featured:
- **Gary Brooker** on lead vocals and piano
- **Matthew Fisher** on Hammond organ
- **Ray Royer** on guitar
- **David Knights** on bass
- Session drummer **Bill Eyden** (as the band didn't have a permanent drummer at the time)

The song was recorded at Olympic Sound Studios in London and became a massive worldwide hit, reaching No. 1 in the UK for six weeks and helping define the "Summer of Love." Gary Brooker was the distinctive lead vocalist whose voice made the song iconic.
